meta.title: d-trash
meta.description: Manage session trash and permanently delete local session logs.

trash.confirmDelete: Physically delete “{title}”? This cannot be undone.
trash.confirmEmpty: Physically delete all sessions in trash? This cannot be undone.
trash.sessionLockBusy: This session is currently open or in use. Switch to another session (or restart DSH), then retry Delete forever. A loaded session may remain locked after switching; restart DSH if it still fails.
trash.physicalDeletion: Physical deletion permanently removes local session logs and cannot be undone.
trash.purgePending: Deletion is unfinished. Retry physical deletion to complete cleanup.
trash.deferred: Pending deletion (automatically completes after restarting DSH)
trash.deferredNotice: Queued for deletion. Restart DSH to complete it; Restore cancels the queue. {reason}
trash.clipboardUnavailable: Clipboard access is unavailable in this context.
trash.copyErrorUnknown: Clipboard write failed without an error message.
trash.copyManually: Full ID selected below. Press Cmd/Ctrl+C to copy.
